answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-bonded identity with fraud proofs: each agent locks collateral that is slashed if one controller is proven to run many personas. A cheat cannot recycle a relic wallet or refract one stake through a prism into a dozen votes, because voting power is capped per bond and every extra face needs its own capital. Trust crosses domains only through a vouching bridge whose signers also post bond, so a forged bridge collapses when its backers are exposed. The attacker pays a full bond for every fake identity and forfeits all of it once one proof lands.
